title: Desk surface protocol v0
description: The one contract between the compositor and anything that draws a surface (ADR 0141): a web surface's host (CEF off-screen) today, a native plugin's process in Stage 3. Engine-neutral. Each message is one JSON object with a type and the surface it is about; CompositorMessage is what the compositor sends, SurfaceMessage what a surface sends. File descriptors and Mach ports travel out of band, beside the message that names them by index.

CompositorMessage.description: A message the compositor sends to a surface: its lifecycle, the release of its textures, its frame pace, input, IME, drag and drop, accessibility requests, and a native plugin's page messages.

SurfaceMessage.description: A message a surface sends to the compositor: that it is ready or died, its title, its frames and frame rate, its cursor, the focus it hands back, its IME state, its drags, its accessibility tree, and a native plugin's page messages.

SurfaceId.description: The compositor's name for one surface, unique while the desk runs. The compositor picks it in create; every later message about the surface carries it, so one connection can carry many surfaces.

SurfaceSize.description: A size in logical pixels (CSS pixels, points): what layout sees. The texture is this times the scale, rounded.

SurfaceScale.description: Physical pixels per logical pixel on the display the surface is on: 1, 1.25, 2.

SurfaceFormat.description: A texture's pixel format: 8 bits per channel, sRGB, alpha premultiplied. bgra8 is what every engine and OS composites natively; rgba8 is for producers that cannot give it.

SurfaceRect.description: A rectangle in the surface's logical pixels, from its top left: carets, accessibility bounds.

SurfacePixelRect.description: A rectangle in a texture's pixels, from its top left, inside the texture: damage.

SurfaceModifier.description: A modifier key held during an input event. meta is Command on macOS and the Windows or Super key elsewhere; caps-lock is the lock being on.

SurfaceModifiers.description: The modifier keys held, each at most once; empty when none.

SurfaceTextRange.description: A range of text in UTF-16 code units, as the DOM counts: start at or before end; start = end is a caret.
